props.text: The Sun and planets are spherical Frames placed in a 3D Cartesian scene; each shows its surface map, spins on its tilted axis, and orbits at its true period (days per second sets the pace). Not to scale: distances grow with the square root of the true distance, radii are exaggerated, and spins are slowed. Drag to orbit the view, scroll to zoom. Planet and star textures: [Solar System Scope](https://www.solarsystemscope.com/textures/), CC BY 4.0.
